blocker.summary: The issued paper gate (pantheon-dev-paper-provisioner, dev paper grant) cannot decide persona_lifecycle_transition decisions on the deployed stack
blocker.detail: services/governance/paper_approval_scope.py require_paper_owned_decision requires owner_user_id == grant subject, target_type == registry_entry, low risk and the exact grant authorization_scope. Enrolment decisions are owned by the proposer, target persona_lifecycle_transition. Verified by calling the function: DENIED 'Dev paper principal may not act on another owner's decision'. So the deployed stack still cannot finish enrolment until Governance paper-grant policy is widened for this target or another decider principal is approved; both are outside this task's scoped files and need an operator decision.
